about.what: Reference values for tests/test_regression.py: the outputs of the original NEURAL (see made_with) for one synthetic EDF file (see input). Made by tests/make_reference.py.
about.input: The synthetic EDF file made by tests/synthetic_edf.py; sha256 is its checksum.
about.artefact_report: Second output of preprocessing_EEG.main_preprocessing: for each artefact check, the % of samples removed in the worst channel; and the bipolar channels removed.
about.preprocessed: Fingerprint of the first output of main_preprocessing (bipolar EEG, 64 Hz): per channel, NaN count, NaN stretches as [first, last + 1] sample indices, mean, std, min, max (of the non-NaN samples), and every 500th sample.
about.features: Per feature, the outputs of generate_all_features(data, feat_set=[feature]): columns (one per frequency band); feats_median_all (median over channels and epochs); feat_st; feats_median_ch [epochs][bands]; feats_per_epochs [channels][epochs][bands], not for connectivity features, which compare pairs of channels.
about.null: null means NaN (not a number), e.g. an epoch NEURAL skipped because it was mostly artefact.
